_readme: Functions granted EXECUTE to `authenticated` that check-dormant-rpcs.mjs must not fail on.
An entry is a debt, not an absolution. The gate exists because this codebase repeatedly shipped
complete server work no button could reach (BACKLOG.md G1-G11). Every row below names a function
in exactly that state, and every one has an open BACKLOG row. Delete the entry when the caller
lands -- do not delete the entry to make the gate quiet.
All six were exposed at once when the gate stopped treating a migration comment as a call site.
Naming a function in prose -- as a good comment does when it explains why something was removed --
had been enough to excuse it from the check. The `zero dormant RPCs` this branch reported before
that fix was not true; six is the real number.

unassign_organization_release_cohort.reason: Restored by 20260804160000 to close the one-way door 20260802030000 left behind: that migration dropped the unassign side while keeping assign, so an organization could be put into a release cohort and nothing supported could take it out. The console that called it was deleted on purpose in the same migration and is deliberately not being re-added here. The function is the supported exit; the surface that calls it is the open work.

admin_emergency_update_course_block.reason: Pre-existing on main and never called. An emergency edit path for a published course block, complete with its own audit trail, that no admin screen offers.

get_resident_administrative_packet.reason: Pre-existing on main and never called. The current wrapper in a chain of renamed predecessors (_base, _before_dietary, _before_calendar); each rename kept the grant, and nothing reads the packet it assembles.

grant_duty_eligibility_override.reason: Pre-existing on main and never called. Duty eligibility can be evaluated and refused, but the documented override that would let a supervisor accept the risk has no way in.

is_employee_access_active.reason: Pre-existing on main and never called, from either client source or another function body. Reads as a helper predicate, but nothing in the database uses it either, so it is dead rather than internal.

revoke_offline_service_device.reason: Pre-existing on main and never called. Offline service devices can be registered but not revoked -- the same one-way-door shape as the survey-packet guest grants closed in G9.
